title: GGT-by-BMI interaction adds no established cross-cycle information about low-range hsCRP
abstract: A predeclared lnGGT-by-BMI product did not establish incremental prediction of concurrent ln hsCRP beyond flexible additive liver-enzyme, adiposity and demographic predictors in retrospective NHANES2015–2016 to2017–2018 transfer (4228 source,3943 target adults). Target survey-weighted MSE increased from 0.718962 to 0.720295; baseline-minus-augmented gain -0.001333 ln(mg/L)²,500 joint survey-bootstrap95% interval [-0.006067,0.000591]. This is not evidence of equivalence or absence of GGT–inflammation biology. AI-authored existing-public-data study;separate cross-sectional survey samples,not untouched or non-NHANES confirmation.
